translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Hinttenoo, Samaariyaa mac'c'awanttoo, Baasaane gadiyaa mac'c'a miizzatuwaadan mod'd'eeddawanttoo, hawaa sisite! Hintte hiyyeesatuwaa uk'k'unniita; mank'k'otuwaakka tuggayiita. Hintte asinatuwaakka, «Nuw ushshaa hammite» yaagiita.

Ubbaa Mooddiyaa Med'inaa Goday hawaadan yaagiide, bare geeshshatetsaan c'ak'k'a; «Hintte maaggan oyk'k'iide gooshettana gallassaynne hintteppe atteeda amareedawanttukka maaggan oyk'k'iide biyaa moletuwaadan hanana gallassay yaana.
Hintte ubbaykka dirssaa s'oo'iyaanna goochchina kesiide, Hermmoonen olettana» yaagiide c'aak'k'eedda Med'inaa Goday.
Israa'eeliyaa Asay Bare Balaappe Tamaaranaw Danddayibeykkino

Ubbaa Mooddiyaa Med'inaa Goday hawaadan yaagee; «Hinttenoo, Israa'eeliyaa asatoo, biite; Beeteele biide, nagaraa ootsite; Galggalakka biide, nagaraa gujjiide ootsite. Wontta wontta hintte yarshshuwaa yarshshite; heezzentso gallassi gallassi hintte asiraataa ahite. Irshshuwaa yeggiide uukkeedda ukitsaa s'uugiide, galataa yarshshuwaa yarshshite. Hintte hintte dosuwaan immiyaawaa diraw, otorettiidde awaayite. Ayaw gooppe, hintte ootsanaw dosiyaawe hewaa» yaagee.
K'aykka Med'inaa Goday hawaadan yaagee; «Hintte katamaa ubbaan taani koshaa yeddaade, haray atto hintte matan das'iyaabaakka d'ayissaad; shin hintte hewaankka taakko simmibeykkita.

Katsaa c'akkiyaa wodii gakkanaw biro heezzu aginay de'ishshin, taani hinttenttoo iraa te"aad. Taani itti kataman iraa bukissaade hara kataman bukkennaadan diggaad; itti shoyk'aan bukkeedda; hara bukkibeenna shoyk'ay k'ay meleedda.
Hewaa diraw, laa"u woy heezzu katamatuwaa Asay haatsaa ushanaw itti katamaa beeddino; shin alibeykkino. Hewankka k'ay hintte taakko simmibeykkita» yaagee Med'inaa Goday.

Med'inaa Goday, «Taani hintte katsaa bollan harggiyaa yeddaad; hintte ataakilttiyaanne hintte woyniyaa turaa, hintte balasiyaa mitsaanne hintte wogaraa ubbaa boolii meedda; shin hintte hewaankka taakko simmibeykkita» yaagee.

Med'inaa Goday, «Taani Gibs'e asatuwaa bolla iita harggiyaa yeddeeddawaadan, hintte bollankka boshaa yeddaad; hintte wodalla naanatuwaa mashshaan wod'aad; hintte paratuukka omoodettanaadan udaad. Hintte mootsan hayk'k'eedda asaa anhaa s'ink'k'uwaan hinttena ulaad; shin hintte hewaankka taakko simmibeykkita» yaagee.

Med'inaa Goday, «Sodoomanne Gamoora katamatuwaa d'aysseeddawaadan, hintteppekka darotuwaa d'ayissaad; ha atteeda hinttekka tamaappe ees's'iidde atteeda s'iifa mala; shin hintte hewaankka taakko simmibeykkita» yaagee.

S'oossay, «Hewaa diraw, Israa'eeliyaa asatoo, taani hinttena hewaadan ootsaade murana hanay. Taani hinttena hawaadan ootsaade murana haniyaa diraw, Israa'eeliyaa asaw, hintte S'oossaanna gakkettanaw giigite» yaagee.

Deretuwaa giigisseeddawe, c'arkkuwaakka med'd'eeddawe, bare wozanaa k'ofaa asaw k'onc'c'issiyaawe, wontta poo'uwaa d'umaw laammiyaawe, gadiyaan de'iyaa d'ok'k'a deretuwaa yed'd'iyaawe, aw suntsay Med'inaa Godaa, Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama S'oossaa.
